MMB Tuesday Ride at Monument Preserve

Monument, CO

MMB Tuesday Ride at Monument Preserve is a mountain bike group ride in Monument, CO. It meets every Tuesday, 5:30 pm, May through October, starting at Mount Herman Trailhead. Expect about 10–12 miles, intermediate to advanced, up tempo.

About the MMB Tuesday Ride at Monument Preserve group ride

An after-work trail ride north of Colorado Springs with moderate technical terrain. The group is upfront that it is not a beginner club. Post-ride hangout at Routes Outfitters. The same group runs a mellower Thursday ride at Black Forest Regional Park.
